Title: EV Dashboard POC with Power BI
Description: Visteon is looking for talented engineers to participate in a Proof of Concept (POC) aimed at modernizing our Electric Vehicle (EV) dashboards. This project will heavily utilize Microsoft Power BI to visualize battery management systems, predictive range analytics, and driver behavioral data in real-time. As an integral part of this innovation initiative, you will be designing interactive dashboards that aggregate telemetry data from our latest EV cockpit prototypes. You will explore advanced DAX functions, custom visuals, and real-time streaming datasets to provide actionable insights for our Connected Services team. We are aiming to create a highly intuitive and responsive interface that sets a new standard for internal data reporting and potentially influences future production designs. Candidates should have a strong grasp of data visualization principles and a keen interest in automotive analytics.
MentorBio: Karthik is a Lead Data Architect with over 12 years of experience in automotive analytics. He specializes in Power BI and has successfully led multiple data modernization initiatives across Visteon's global teams.

Title: AI Defect Classifier for ADAS
Description: Join the ADAS Engineering team in building a cutting-edge AI Defect Classifier to improve our manufacturing quality control. In this project, you will develop computer vision models using Python and popular machine learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch. The goal is to automate the detection of microscopic defects in Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) sensor components during the assembly line process. You will be dealing with high-resolution image datasets, performing data augmentation, training convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and optimizing the model for edge deployment. This is a fantastic opportunity to apply theoretical ML knowledge to a practical, high-impact manufacturing problem. Successful implementation of this classifier is expected to significantly reduce manual inspection time and enhance the overall reliability of our safety-critical ADAS products. We are looking for self-starters passionate about artificial intelligence and its applications in the automotive industry.
MentorBio: Priya is a Senior AI Engineer specializing in computer vision for autonomous driving systems. She has been instrumental in developing Visteon's next-generation ADAS perception algorithms and holds multiple patents in the field.

Title: SharePoint Migration Helper Tool
Description: The IT Infra team is spearheading a critical project to migrate legacy intranet portals to modern SharePoint Online. To streamline this massive effort, we need a custom SharePoint Migration Helper Tool. This tool will be built using a combination of SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Automate, and Power Apps. You will be responsible for automating the content assessment phase, identifying outdated pages, and creating automated workflows to route content to respective owners for review before migration. The project involves deep integration with Microsoft 365 APIs, creating custom Power Automate connectors, and designing a user-friendly Power Apps interface for content owners. This initiative will not only accelerate our enterprise-wide migration but also give you hands-on experience with the latest Microsoft Power Platform capabilities in a large-scale corporate environment. Strong scripting and logical problem-solving skills are essential.
RequiredSkills: Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint API
MentorBio: Rajesh is a SharePoint Architect with a decade of experience in enterprise collaboration tools. He leads the digital workplace transformation initiatives and is a recognized expert in Microsoft 365 governance.

Title: Embedded HMI Test Automation
Description: The Cockpit Systems team in Goa is looking to revolutionize our testing procedures for Embedded Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI). This learning sprint focuses on developing a robust test automation framework using Embedded C and scripting languages. You will be working directly with our latest infotainment hardware, writing scripts that simulate user inputs, CAN bus signals, and environmental variables to validate the HMI software's stability and responsiveness. The project aims to transition our testing from manual, time-consuming processes to a continuous integration pipeline. You'll learn how to interface with hardware test rigs, parse system logs for error detection, and generate automated test reports. This is an excellent opportunity for engineers looking to bridge the gap between software development and hardware validation in the fast-paced automotive cockpit domain.
RequiredSkills: Embedded C, Python Scripting, Testing Frameworks
MentorBio: Anjali is a Principal Test Engineer with extensive background in automotive infotainment systems. She is passionate about test-driven development and mentoring junior engineers in embedded software quality assurance.

Title: Power Platform COE Governance
Description: As Visteon's adoption of low-code solutions accelerates, the Digital Transformation team is establishing a Center of Excellence (COE) for the Power Platform. We need assistance in defining and implementing governance guardrails. In this project, you will help configure the Power Platform Starter Kit, set up Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies, and create automated workflows to monitor app usage and compliance across the organization. You'll analyze existing app deployments to identify orphaned or high-risk applications and work on an internal communication strategy to educate makers on best practices. This role provides a unique, top-down view of enterprise application management and is ideal for someone interested in IT governance, security, and strategic planning within the Microsoft ecosystem.
RequiredSkills: Power Platform Admin Center, Governance, Strategy
MentorBio: Vikram leads the Digital Transformation office and drives the adoption of modern workplace technologies. He has successfully established IT governance frameworks for Fortune 500 companies globally.

Title: UI/UX Redesign for Dealer Portal
Description: The Customer Experience team is embarking on a comprehensive UI/UX redesign of our global Dealer Portal. This client-facing proof of concept aims to modernize the interface, improve navigation, and enhance the overall user journey for our dealership partners. You will collaborate closely with product managers and end-users to conduct usability testing, create wireframes, and develop high-fidelity interactive prototypes using tools like Figma or Adobe XD. The focus will be on responsive design, accessibility standards, and aligning the visual identity with Visteon's brand guidelines. This project requires a keen eye for aesthetics, an understanding of user-centered design principles, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into intuitive digital experiences.
MentorBio: Sneha is a Lead UX Designer who champions user-centric design methodologies. She has designed award-winning enterprise applications and frequently speaks at design conferences on inclusive design practices.

Title: Predictive Maintenance ML Model
Description: This completed innovation project successfully developed a predictive maintenance machine learning model for our global manufacturing plants. The team analyzed years of historical machine sensor data, maintenance logs, and production metrics to identify patterns preceding equipment failure. Using Python, scikit-learn, and time-series analysis techniques, they created a robust algorithm that predicts potential breakdowns with 85% accuracy up to 48 hours in advance. The model's outputs were integrated into a real-time Power BI dashboard, providing floor managers with actionable alerts. This initiative has already demonstrated a significant reduction in unplanned downtime at our pilot facility in Bangalore, proving the immense value of data-driven manufacturing intelligence at Visteon.
MentorBio: Arun is a Data Science Manager focusing on Industry 4.0 initiatives. He bridges the gap between complex statistical modeling and tangible manufacturing efficiencies.

Title: CAN Bus Data Logger Optimization
Description: This intensive learning sprint tackled the optimization of our proprietary CAN Bus Data Logger software used in vehicle networking tests. The team successfully refactored legacy Embedded C and .NET code to improve data capture rates and reduce memory consumption during high-load scenarios. By implementing more efficient buffer management and multi-threading techniques, the logger can now process complex CAN FD traffic without dropping frames. This project not only enhanced a critical internal tool but also provided the participants with deep insights into automotive network protocols and high-performance system programming. The optimized logger is now deployed across all our vehicle networking validation benches globally.
MentorBio: Rohan is a Senior Software Architect with a deep expertise in vehicle network protocols. He has designed several of Visteon's core diagnostic and logging tools used worldwide.
